[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-enet-review —— 嘉立创网表原理图校对（DSH 插件）

把「解析嘉立创 EDA 导出网表（`.enet`）并校对原理图」这件事，做成 DeepSeek Harness 里
**agent 可以直接调用**的 9 个只读工具 + 2 个技能。

**纯 JS、零运行时依赖。** 不需要 Python、不需要 npm install、不需要构建步骤 ——
因为本机 `PATH` 里没有 `node`，两个 Python 解释器又各缺一半 PDF 库，
自包含是唯一可靠的做法（原始 Python 版保留在遗留工程里作为 CLI 参照）。

---

## 这个插件能发现什么

| 类别 | 例子 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| **断链** | `OAMP_6.5V` 和 `OAMP_+6.5V` 是两个不相连的网络，中间没有任何元件 | P0 |
| **FDA 反馈接反** | 全差分放大器反馈从同侧取 → 正反馈 → 一上电就饱和 | P0 |
| **电源轨孤儿** | 一条电源轨找不到源，或者只有源没有负载 | P1 |
| **网络接进不贴的器件** | 网络连到了标记为 NC 的器件 | P1 |
| **悬空脚** | `EN` / `RESET` / `MUTE` 挂在只有一个成员的网络里 | P2 |
| **引脚名与网络冲突** | 负压 LDO 的 `VIN` 接在正压网上 | P2 |
| **兄弟封装引脚序混用** | 同封装不同型号，引脚序不同 | P2 |
| **规则自身异常** | 某条规则跑挂了 → **审计不完整，不能当通过** | P3 |

### 差分对不会误报（关键设计）

丢弃非字母数字后 `DAC_OUTL+` 和 `DAC_OUTL-` 是"同名"的，但**正负号是极性语义**。
判定用「正号等价键」：

| 网络对 | 键 | 判定 |
|---|---|---|
| `OAMP_6.5V` / `OAMP_+6.5V` | 同为 `oamp65v` | **报断链**（实测复现旧项目） |
| `DAC_OUTL+` / `DAC_OUTL-` | `dacoutl+` / `dacoutl-` | **不报**，正常差分对 |
| `-5V` / `5V` | `-5v` / `5v` | 不报，极性真的相反，交人工判断 |

有跨接元件的相似标签降为 P3（仅命名不一致，**不是断链**）；
无跨接的才是 P0。修这个之前，差分对一次误报 7 对，报告直接失去可信度。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：一行搞定（**已实测**）

在 DSH 会话里让 agent 执行：

```
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "C:\\Users\\lishuo\\Documents\\deepseek-harness\\default-workspace\\dsh-enet-review" })
```

它会自动把两处都写好，不需要手改 profile：

| 它写什么 | 写到哪 |
|---|---|
| `"@local/dsh-enet-review": "link:C:/…/dsh-enet-review"` | profile `package.json` → `dependencies` |
| `"@local/dsh-enet-review"` | profile `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles`（**追加到末尾**） |

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` **不会**被改 —— 插件行由插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`
经 bundle 机制注入。

返回里读 `application`：`applied` = 已生效；`failed` = 有插件行没激活，看 `error.diagnostic`。

> ⚠️ `install_bundle` 需要 danger-full-access 权限或当次批准（该 action 不弹交互确认，
> 策略为 `never` 时也能执行）。

#### 如果第一次装的时候源码有毛病（本插件踩过，值得记下来）

实际遇到过的顺序：

1. 第一次 `install_bundle` → `application: "failed"`，
   `error.diagnostic` = `dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate / enet-review (@local/dsh-enet-review): failed to import`。
2. 修好源码后**再跑一次 `install_bundle`** → `changed: false` + `error.code: "ambiguous-install"`，
   **它不会重新尝试导入**，`application` 仍然是 `failed`。**这一步会骗人：看起来像还没修好。**
3. 真正有效的动作是对那一行做一次 disabled → enabled 的往返（走 profile 配置热重载）：

   ```
   plugin_manager({ action: "set_plugin", target: "include:enet-review", enabled: false })
   plugin_manager({ action: "set_plugin", target: "include:enet-review", enabled: true })
   ```

   第二次返回 `application: "applied"`、`warnings: []`，**不需要重启**。

entry id 形如 `include:<patchId>`；不确定时用
`cordis_inspect_query({platform:"host", provider:"Config", method:"listConfigs", input:{name:"@local/dsh-enet-review"}})`
拿准确 id。注意该返回里的 `status` 是 **Config schema 状态**（`absent` = 插件活着但没导出
`Config`），**不是**激活状态；激活状态要去 `plugin_manager list_plugins` 看 `fiberPhase`。

#### 怎么确认真的生效了

```powershell
# 1) 插件行在不在、激活没有
plugin_manager({ action: "list_plugins" })        # 找 include:enet-review → "fiberPhase":"active"
# 2) 9 个工具 agent 到底看不看得见
cordis_inspect_query({ platform: "host", provider: "Tool", method: "listTools" })
```

### 方式 B：手动 link（不推荐，目前唯一能跑通的形态有硬约束）

`install_bundle` 内部干的就是这件事：`dependencies` 写
`"@local/dsh-enet-review": "link:<绝对路径>"`，`dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾追加同名项。
手改 profile 是官方明确不推荐的（改坏了没有回滚），能走方式 A 就走 A。

> **硬约束**：以 `link:` 装载的插件，**不能 `import` 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包**。
> 原因：`cordis-plugin-loader` 对裸说明符走 Node 原生 `import()`，按插件目录的
> **真实路径**向上找 `node_modules`；而宿主包（`dsh-tools` / `dsh-skill` / `cordis`）
> 在 Desktop 下只存在于 `app.asar` 内，磁盘上没有
> （`profiles\desktop\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\` 里只有 `cosmokit` 和 `schemastery`）。
> 症状：`Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools' … ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`，
> 整行 `failed to import`。
> 从 npm / GitHub 装进 profile 的**真包**没有这个问题 —— 所以同一个 API，
> 别人能用，本地的 link 插件不能用。
>
> 本插件的对策：自带 `lib/define-tool.js`（`defineTool` 的等价零依赖实现），
> 全包**只 import `node:*` 和相对路径**。`_selftest.mjs` 里有一组
> 「无宿主依赖（可被 link 装载）」断言，递归扫所有 `.js`/`.mjs` 的 import 说明符来守住这条底线。
> 参照实现：`@local/dsh-chat-mode` 用的是同一招 —— patch 里 `name: './policy.js'`，
> 把逻辑放在**包根**由 loader 以相对路径加载，`policy.js` 同样不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`。

### 自检

```powershell
$node = 'C:\Users\lishuo\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe'
cd C:\Users\lishuo\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\dsh-enet-review
& $node _selftest.mjs
```

输出 `全部通过` 即 OK。自检覆盖：纯函数 + 坏输入 + BOOK 手册查找 + 技能发现（mock
`SkillProviderControl`）+ **工具定义（本地 `defineTool` 的参数编译与校验）** +
**无宿主依赖扫描** + 真实网表的 10 项断言（含「差分对不被误报」回归断言）。

---

## 9 个工具

所有工具**只读**：不改 `.enet`、不改工程、不写文件。
`file` 参数都可省略 —— 会从当前目录向上自动找 `*.enet`。

| 工具 | 用途 | 参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `enet_netlist` | 网表概览 / 元件清单 / 网络清单 | `file` `components` `nets` `grep` `limit` |
| `enet_audit` | 跑全部规则，按 P0→P3 返回 | `file` `severity` `detail` |
| `enet_dangling` | 单脚网络（有源器件优先） | `file` `all` |
| `enet_net` | 单个网络的成员，可顺带列"孪生网" | `net` `file` `similar` |
| `enet_part` | 单位号：每个引脚 → 网络（带推断标签） | `des` `file` |
| `enet_link` | 两个网络之间的跨接元件（判定断链用） | `net1` `net2` `file` |
| `enet_fda` | 全差分放大器反馈交叉判定 | `des` `file` |
| `enet_datasheet` | 三级降级手册查找 | `part` `supplierPart` `online` `dir` |
| `enet_pin_infer` | 引脚名推断（可结合实连网络给矛盾提示） | `pinName` `des` `pin` `file` |

### 典型用法

```
enet_netlist()                                     # 先看规模
enet_audit()                                       # 全量审计
enet_link({ net1: "OAMP_6.5V", net2: "OAMP_+6.5V" })   # 确认是否真断链
enet_part({ des: "U23" })                          # 看某颗芯片每脚连到哪
enet_datasheet({ part: "ES9038Q2M" })              # 查手册（先查本地 BOOK）
```

---

## 2 个技能

| 技能 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `enet-review` | 完整校对流程（8 步）、分级口径、判定话术、**数据手册三级查找硬性规则**、7 条陷阱 |
| `datasheet-lookup` | 数据手册查找独立技能：BOOK → 联网 → 按引脚名推断（必须标注"未核对手册"） |

### 数据手册查找优先级（硬性）

```
C:\Users\lishuo\Documents\BOOK          ← 第一级：约 248 个 PDF，归一化模糊匹配
        ↓ 找不到
联网（立创商城 / 搜索链接，只返回候选不自动下载）
        ↓ 无网络
按引脚名称推断 —— 必须标注「推断，未核对手册」，置信度上限 medium
```

**禁止**把推断写成"手册规定"。**禁止**把 `partial`/`family` 级匹配说成"已找到手册"。

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-enet-review/
  package.json            插件 manifest（dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml）
  cordis.patch.yml        insert: id=enet-review / name=@local/dsh-enet-review
  index.js                入口：inject=['tools','skills']，apply() 注册工具 + 技能 provider
  lib/
    designator.js         位号/引脚号自然排序；三种网络名规范化键
    netlist.js            parseEnet / readEnet / class Netlist（含 similarLabelPairs）
    pininfer.js           22 条引脚名推断规则
    rules.js              8 条校对规则 + audit()
    datasheet.js          BOOK 目录模糊查找（exact / partial / family 三档打分）
    datasheet-online.js   联网兜底（立创商城 GET + 搜索链接）
    frontmatter.js        SKILL.md frontmatter 解析（支持 | 和 > 块标量）
    skills.js             技能 provider（递归扫描 skills/**/SKILL.md）
    tools.js              9 个工具定义
    define-tool.js        defineTool 的零依赖等价实现（link 装载不能 import @deepseek-ai/*，见「方式 B」）
  skills/
    enet-review/SKILL.md      校对主技能
    datasheet-lookup/SKILL.md 手册查找技能
  references/
    enet-format.md        .enet 的 JSON 结构与字段语义
    audit-playbook.md     完整流程与判定话术对照表
    case-notes.md         真实案例（CH32V305 音频板）—— 仅案例，非通用规则
  _selftest.mjs           自检（不依赖 DSH 宿主）
  tools/dump.mjs          开发诊断脚本
```

---

## 参考实现来源

- 工具注册：`dsh-meme` 的 `defineTool` 用法；`lib/define-tool.js` 按其宿主实现
  （`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:838-887` 的 `defineTool` + `:792-811` 的
  `parameterSchemaSpecToJsonSchema` / `valueSchemaSpecToJsonSchema`）等价重写
- 技能 provider：`@dhicoc/dsh-reverse-skill`（`resolveBundledRoot` + `collect` + `createProvider`）
  与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-badge`（53 行最小范例）
- 遗留 CLI 参照：`C:\Users\lishuo\XiaomiMiMoProjects\原理图校对\scripts\enet.py`

plugins.description: Deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - monotonic guard seam, operator-declared policy, decision ledger. Gate: 12/12 green, 2000 benign FP=0, injected 7/7 caught.
plugins.readme_text:
# @phm-audit/dsh-action-guard

A deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), registered through the official **monotonic guard seam** (`ctx.tools.guard`).

> DeepSeek Harness follows an "everything is a plugin" architecture. This plugin fills one concrete slot: a rules-based, operator-declared guard whose verdicts are reproducible and whose decisions are recorded.

Gate test artifact: 2009-frame deterministic command stream (2000 benign + 7 injected violations + determinism/ledger/pathological-input checks, no RNG, no network) — **0 false positives on benign, all injected violations caught by the intended rule**, 12/12 vitest cases green (2026-10-13). Run: `bash run_demo.sh`.

End-to-end smoke: the Cordis wrapper is additionally verified against the **published npm packages** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-10-13) — loaded the cordis way (`ctx.plugin`, `static inject` resolved), a real tool registered, and a real `execute()` call to a non-allowlisted tool **denied with the expected R-unknown reason through the actual pipeline** (3/3 smoke cases). Version-pinned smoke: the harness is under active development; re-run `npx vitest run tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against your deployed version.

## What it checks (all operator-declared, all deterministic)

- **R-unknown** — tool must be in the declared allowlist
- **R-keys** — forbidden parameter keys per tool
- **R-equals** — denied parameter values per tool
- **R-bounds** — numeric parameter bounds per tool (inclusive)
- **Fail-closed** — an internal evaluation error denies with a distinctive reason (a broken guard can never silently become a hole)
- **Decision ledger** — every verdict appended to a local JSONL ledger with a chain id (correlation artifact for incident forensics; FNV-based chain id, not a tamper-proofing guarantee)

## Method lineage — PHM

This plugin is the harness-native expression of the **PHM deterministic-verification methodology** (gate-first, evidence-first), whose parent project [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) is validated on the **AgentDojo official benchmark with a real LLM in the loop** (no ASR/FP events in the v2.2 re-run, FP fix-cycle 16 → 1 → 0 published, all artifacts open with SHA-256 chains, third-party thread engagement on record).

What that lineage means concretely, versus the (crowded, 155-plugin) Security & Permissions category:

1. **Official third-party benchmark lineage** — the parent method is measured on AgentDojo, not only on self-built samples (verified 2026-10-13 across a 10-repo sample of direct competitors: none cites an industry-standard benchmark; the closest, dsh-defend, uses a self-built 105-sample red-team set).
2. **Cross-domain deployment record** — the same gate criteria (benign FP=0 / injected FN=0 / deterministic repeats / fail-closed / audit ledger) run in robot (Unitree official-URDF gate), traffic-flow (845k-frame NGSIM), and SDK-contract lines — a method with a track record, not a one-off plugin.
3. **Open, recomputable evidence** — every claim in this README has an on-disk artifact: gate counts in `tests/`, smoke in `tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against published npm versions, SHA-256SUMS manifest.

The category being crowded is stated on purpose: this plugin's value is the evidence chain and the standard-interface demonstration, not feature uniqueness.

## Channel facts (from the #9614 review — thanks @argszero)

Four properties of the guard seam that scope what this plugin's ledger and rules can claim, verified against `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` at master (`d743267388`):

1. **The ledger is a guard-layer record, not a complete decision record.** The guard runs only when the pre-execute waterfall returned `allow` (and the user did not refuse an ask, and the call was not cancelled upstream). Denials owned by other layers never enter the guard — a complete audit record needs `tools/pre-execute` + `tools/post-execute` as writers. Our JSONL ledger describes exactly this layer and nothing more.
2. **`R-unknown` is a *name* allowlist, not a *tool* allowlist.** `execution.name` can resolve to different registered definitions across scopes (scope registrations shadow inherited entries). A same-named shadow preset is indistinguishable to the guard.
3. **PTC mode changes the traffic shape.** Model-direct calls of native tool names are denied upstream (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) before the policy pipeline; nested sub-dispatches *do* reach the guard (inheriting `rootCallId`). Policies must therefore cover sub-dispatch argument shapes too, and the allowlist only sees what actually arrives.
4. **Structured denial metadata is channel-forced external.** A guard can only return a string; `denialInfo` in the pipeline comes from the waterfall's decision. The separate JSONL ledger is the channel's requirement, not a stylistic choice — and the refusal reason is model-facing (`Error: <reason>` is the tool result), so keep reasons short and carry the rule id (`action-guard: … (R-bounds)`) to correlate with the ledger.

**Why the guard seam (and not a `tools/pre-execute` listener):** a guard is monotonic — no other layer can force-allow what it denied — while a pre-execute listener sits in a waterfall it does not own, and one early `allow` ends the chain for everyone after it. Deterministic, synchronous, name+arguments policy belongs here; operator-visible asks belong to the waterfall.

**Mount-point note:** all guards are monotonic-deny, so the outcome is order-independent — but the *reported reason* is the first one found (global first, then scope chain farthest-first). If your policy can deny the same call from two layers, pin a single mount point to keep reported rule ids unambiguous.

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

- The policy is **operator-declared** — this is not a general safety oracle, and it does not replace the harness's own permission/sandbox/approval layers; it composes with them at the guard seam.
- Same-source fix cycles are not independent stability trials. The 2009-frame gate is a mechanism demonstration, not a statistical claim.
- The guard core is a pure function (`src/guard-core.ts`, zero dependencies); the Cordis wrapper (`src/index.ts`) imports `ToolGuard` from the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package and is smoke-tested as described above. One earlier revision imported a wrong internal-only package name; the smoke test against npm packages is the guard against that class of error.
- Ledger writes are best-effort and contained; they cannot affect the verdict path.

## Plugin shape (matches harness plugin conventions)

```ts
export const name = 'action-guard'
export const inject = ['tools']
export interface Config { policy: GuardPolicy; ledger?: { path: string } }
export default apply   // registers one ToolGuard via ctx.tools.guard()
```

## License

MIT.

---

plugins.description: Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images through any OpenAI-compatible image backend
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-imagegen

Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images
through any OpenAI-compatible image backend, so agents can generate images
without per-backend glue. The same tool lists the configured routes, echoes
the declared model lists, and live-probes the backends.

## Tool verbs

| verb        | network | what it does |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `generate`  | yes     | Generates the requested images. The tool writes the image files to disk and runs magic-byte checks on them. |
| `providers` | no      | Lists the configured routes with their fields, the originating layer of each field, and the credential state. The verb reads the local configuration and makes no network request. |
| `models`    | no      | Echoes the declared model list of each route from the config layer. The verb makes no network request; the live model listing is the `status` verb. |
| `status`    | yes     | Probes each route's `GET {baseURL}/models` endpoint and reports reachability plus the live model list. |

Key `generate` behaviors:

- The `prompt` argument is required, and it is the only required argument.
- When the call omits `model`, the tool uses the route's single declared
  model. When a route declares no models, the tool resolves the model by a
  live `/models` probe. When the declared or probed model list contains
  several models, the call fails and lists the candidates.
- The tool sends `size` and `negativePrompt` verbatim, and only when the call
  sets them. The `seed` argument must be an integer, and the tool sends it
  only when the call sets it. The `n` argument is an integer >= 1 with a
  default of 1, and a value greater than 1 requests a batch.
- When the call sets `out`, the output path is that argument (a file path for
  `n = 1`, or a directory marked by a trailing separator or by existing on
  disk). When the call omits `out`, the tool writes the files to
  `<process.cwd()>/images/<unixts>_<i>.<ext>`. The file extension comes from
  the image magic bytes (`png` / `jpg` / `webp`).
- The tool checks the written bytes for PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. When the
  payload is not a recognized image, the call fails with `code: output`, and
  the tool keeps the file on disk. When the path cannot be written, the call
  fails the same way.
- The generate timeout is 180 s by default, and a `timeout` argument of
  1-3600 s overrides it per call. The probe timeout is 10 s.

The plugin ships a `dsh-imagegen` skill. The skill is the full tool reference
for agent contexts: it carries the parameter table, the env contract, and the
error codes.

## Installation

dsh-imagegen is an out-of-tree plugin for a dsh profile. Install it with the
dsh plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-imagegen
```

Configuration is layered: built-in defaults, the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract, a
cordis patch file, a `dsh-imagegen` settings section (see below); the plugin
creates no config or state files.

## Configuration

Providers are configured in any of four layers, lowest to highest priority;
the `providers` verb reports the originating layer of every field, so a
shadowed value is never silent:

1. the built-in default (`api: openai-compatible`),
2. the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract (static per process boot),
3. the cordis config layer (a patch entry with id `dsh-imagegen` and a
   `config` object, or profile-level patches),
4. the `dsh-imagegen:` section in the user settings document
   (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`), which the plugin re-reads on every call, so
   settings edits apply without a restart.

```yaml
dsh-imagegen:
  defaultProvider: local
  providers:
    local:
      baseURL: http://<host>:<port>/v1
    hosted:
      baseURL: https://api.example.com/v1
      apiKeyEnv: IMAGEGEN_HOSTED_KEY
      models: [flux-1]
      displayName: Hosted Images
```

The env contract mirrors the config fields 1:1: `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`,
and per route `<NAME>` the variables `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_BASEURL`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_API`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_APIKEYENV`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_HEADERS`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_MODELS`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_DISPLAYNAME`. The `<NAME>` segment is the route name
uppercased with `-` written as `_`. The `headers` value is a JSON object
string, and the `models` value is a comma-separated list of model ids. The
`baseURL` value is the OpenAI-compatible base URL including the `/v1` prefix
(the same shape as an LLM provider base URL); the plugin appends
`/images/generations` and `/models` to it verbatim, and the image contract has
no server-root endpoints. The `apiKeyEnv` value is a reference to an
environment variable name, never a secret in config; per request the value
resolves from the process environment, then from
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.

## Examples

```jsonc
// Generate with the default route and its single declared model.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "a lighthouse in fog", "size": "1024x1024" }
// Pick a route and model explicitly, and keep the output name deterministic.
{ "verb": "generate", "provider": "hosted", "model": "flux-1",
  "prompt": "an isometric pixel-art garden", "seed": 42, "out": "/tmp/garden.png" }
// Generate a batch into an existing directory.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "three weather variations", "n": 3, "out": "renders/" }
// List what is configured, and where each field comes from.
{ "verb": "providers" }
// List the declared model lists per route (no network).
{ "verb": "models" }
// Probe the backend health (the live /models probe).
{ "verb": "status" }
```

## Troubleshooting

A failing call returns the document `{ ok: false, error: { code, message,
provider?, elapsed_ms } }`. The code set is `invalid_param` / `config` /
`network` / `timeout` / `http` / `protocol` / `output`.

- When a `config` error carries the message "no provider route is
  configured", no route survived configuration. Check the base URLs; the tool
  reports each route that configuration drops as a warning in the log.
- When a `config` error carries the message "credential missing: environment
  variable "X" is not set", the credential reference does not resolve. Set
  `X` in the environment or add it to `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.
- When a `config` error carries the message "unknown provider "x"", the route
  name matches no configured route. Route names match case-insensitively and
  treat `_` and `-` as the same separator; the error lists the configured
  names.
- When a `config` error carries the message "multiple providers configured
  (...) and no default is set", pass the `provider` argument explicitly, or
  set `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, or set the settings `defaultProvider`.
- When an `output` error carries the message "write failed", the tool could
  not write to the `out` path. Check the directory and its permissions.
- When an `output` error carries the message "not a recognized image", the
  backend returned bytes with no PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. Inspect the kept
  file; the backend may return an unsupported container.

## Build

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # tsc -> lib/
pnpm run lint      # eslint src/ test/
pnpm run selftest  # in-process: HTTP stub + config matrix + magic-byte checks
```

plugins.description: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-provider-badge

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

在 DSH Web 输入框的工具行里，紧挨着模型选择器左侧显示**当前会话所用模型的供应商**。

![输入框工具行里的供应商徽标，位于模型选择器左侧](assets/screenshot-1.png)

## 它显示什么

- 供应商名称取自 Host 模型目录里该模型所属的分组名（`ModelProviderGroup.name`），与 `/model`
  弹窗、模型选择器里的分组标题一致。
- 数据源是与模型选择器**同一个** per-session 模型目录（client 服务 `modelDirectories`）：
  还没选过模型的新会话显示部署默认模型的供应商，切换模型后立即跟着变。
- 供应商已从目录移除时，依次退回上一次广告到的失败名，再退回供应商 id 本身。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:huihuangdi/dsh-model-provider-badge
```

装完**刷新一次页面**——客户端半边由 Web 外壳加载，不由 Host 加载。也可以直接指向本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-provider-badge
```

无构建步骤：纯 JavaScript，没有 install / 生命周期脚本，不涉及 `allowBuilds` 授权。

## 位置与实现

- 座位：`conversation.input.right`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 声明），
  在 DOM 中渲染于模型选择器之前——也就是模型名左边的空位。
- `index.js`：Host 半边，一个普通插件行，外加一个只在 profile 有 Web server 时注册的
  只写诊断路由。
- `client.js`：浏览器半边，经 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载，用 `ctx.slots.inject(...)` +
  `ctx.slots.register(...)` 占住座位。
- 样式只用主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-sm`），尺寸对齐宿主模型座位
  （28px 高、13px/400 字号、4px 间距），因此和同一行的控件是一套视觉。
- 文案走 client locale（命名空间 `model-provider-badge`，内置 zh / en）。

## 自检

```sh
node test/activation.selftest.mjs
```

用真实 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 复刻浏览器里的服务拓扑（服务由**兄弟插件**提供，而不是挂在 root 上），
断言插件激活成功、词典与座位注册成功、注入面只带可安全缓存的值。DSH 装在非默认位置时用
`DSH_INSTALL=<@deepseek-ai/dsh 目录>` 指定。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。方向在面板内直接填，回车即开始。
- **横向对比版本**：版本链横着排，每一版一列，内容直接铺开，不用点开就能看到；每一版都跟左边一版做行级对比，新增标绿、删除标红并划掉。
- **等待有反馈**：优化与迭代期间显示进度条和已等待秒数。
- **模板与历史**：五个内置模板（通用优化 / 结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入（载入后自动切回「优化」页）。「存入历史」把结果那一栏当前的内容存成一条手写版本；「存为模板」才是存成可复用的模板。
- **在新对话中使用**：优化结果那一栏可以直接手改；改完点「在新对话中使用」，选一个工作区，插件就会新开一个对话、把这段提示词填进输入框并直接发送，省掉复制粘贴。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代的系统提示词，以及容错清理
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: Model-free local-handoff compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-local-handoff

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**零模型调用**压缩后端：上下文到达阈值后，用本地、确定性、有界的交接文档代替一次额外的模型摘要调用。

> **English:** A model-free compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness. When the context reaches the compaction threshold, it replaces the extra summarization LLM call with a deterministic, bounded handoff assembled locally from the messages being shadowed — no model call, no cost, no added latency, and reproducible output. Everything else about compaction (trigger threshold, verbatim tail retention, tool-result pruning, span selection, locking, `/compact`) is inherited unchanged from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`. Install it with one `dsh plugin add` plus a host restart, and remove the bundle to get the default backend back.

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11（PowerShell） | ✅ | DSH_HOME 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`。npm 会生成 `dsh.cmd` / `dsh.ps1`，本仓库的 preset 查找识别 `PATHEXT`，`npm run dev:link` 使用目录 junction（无需管理员权限）。已在 Windows 11 + Node 24.19.0 上实机跑通全部测试。 |
| macOS（zsh） | ✅ | DSH_HOME 是 `~/.dsh`。npm 全局 `dsh` 通常是指向真实 `lib/bin.js` 的符号链接，preset 查找会先解析它。查找逻辑有 darwin 布局的单元测试，未在真机重复验证。 |
| Linux（bash/zsh） | ✅ | 与 macOS 同一套 Node 代码路径，`dev:link` 用普通目录符号链接。查找逻辑有 linux 布局的单元测试，未在真机重复验证。 |

运行要求：

- **Node.js**：`>=22`（取自 `package.json` 的 `engines`）。
- **DSH peer**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic >=0.2.0-rc.2`（取自 `package.json` 的 `peerDependencies`）。该包由 DSH 自带，必须能从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析到；本仓库不 vendor 它。
- 纯 ESM，**无构建步骤、无新增 npm 依赖**。

## 安装

1. **确认 Node 和 `dsh` 可用**（PowerShell 与 zsh 相同）：

   ```powershell
   node --version
   dsh --version
   ```

   `node` 需要 `v22` 或更高；`dsh --version` 能输出版本号（本机验证时为 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。

2. **安装 bundle**（两个平台逐字相同，不要改写命令）：

   ```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile web add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
   ```

   这条命令把包写进 profile 的 `dependencies`，并把声明了 `dsh.bundle` 的它追加进有序的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表。两者缺一不可：前者让 Node 能找到模块，后者让它作为补丁层参与启动。

3. **重启该 profile 的 host**。新增模块根不在 HMR 热重载范围内：必须完全退出并重新启动运行 `dsh` 的进程（GUI 即重启应用/后台服务）。只刷新页面、只重载配置都不够。

4. 按[验证](#验证)确认它真的在跑本地后端。

**平台差异只有路径**：

- Windows：DSH_HOME 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，profile 目录是 `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web`。
- macOS / Linux：DSH_HOME 是 `~/.dsh`，profile 目录是 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`。
- `dsh plugin …` 本身没有平台差异。

### 手工安装（等价做法）

`dsh plugin add` 只是把 pnpm 和 bundle 选择一起做了。也可以手工两步（手工路径要求 `pnpm` 在 PATH；没有就先 `npm i -g pnpm`，或者直接用 `dsh plugin add`，它会用 DSH 安装自带的 pnpm）：

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web
pnpm add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
```

```zsh
# macOS / Linux
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
```

然后把包名加入该目录 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
] } }
```

### 为什么 `cordis.patch.yml` 是生成出来的

压缩后端在 profile 里被挂了**两层**，只改一层不够：

1. **profile 根**——`dsh-base` 直接挂了一行 `compaction-basic`；没有自己压缩组的 preset（自定义 preset）继承它。当前随 DSH 发布的四个 preset 都有各自的压缩组。
2. **每个 agent preset 内部的隔离压缩组**——`preset-standard` / `preset-ptc` / `preset-minimal` / `preset-cordis` 各自带一个 `cordis:group`，带 `isolate: { compaction: true }`，里面又挂了一份 `compaction-basic`。**正常 GUI 会话跑在 preset 下，用的是这一份。**

第 2 层无法用普通的按 id patch 命中：preset 行的 `config.plugins` 是**数据**，交给 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` 注册后才在 agent 自己的 scope 里挂载，而 loader 的 `applyEntryPatches` 只下钻 `group: true` 的行（preset 行不是）。

registry 的文档给了官方做法——“A new preset or an override of a shipped one is a bundle patch: an `insert` of a `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row, **or a patch keyed by that row's id**”。所以 `cordis.patch.yml` 由 `scripts/sync-presets.mjs` 生成：读**官方发布的 manifest 文件** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`，**逐字复制**，只把那份 `compaction-basic` 换成 `compaction-local-handoff`，其余（persona、plan-mode、delegation……）保持原样。

来源必须是 manifest 文件，**不能**是 `dsh --dump-default-config`：这个 bundle 自己就是一个 bundle，等 dump 渲染出来时它自己的补丁已经生效了——读 dump 等于读本文件的输出，于是 `check:presets` 拿文件和自己比，永远失败（“no preset with a compaction group found”）。一个**永远不可能通过**的漂移守卫比没有更糟，因为它看起来像保护。

代价要说清楚：这意味着这些 preset 清单在你的 profile 里被**冻结**在生成时的那一版。harness 升级若改动了 shipped preset（新增工具、调整 prompt 段），你不会自动拿到。反向也一样：仓库里的快照是在某个具体 harness 版本上生成的（当前为 `0.2.1-rc.2`），比它旧的 harness 可能不认识快照里新增的 preset 行；`peerDependencies` 只保证压缩钩子存在，不保证 preset 行完全一致。源码检出里可以：

```powershell
npm run check:presets     # 只比较，不写文件；过期时非零退出并打印第一处差异
npm run sync:presets      # 重新生成 cordis.patch.yml
```

- `check:presets` 把生成器当前会产出的结果与仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 比较（换行归一化后逐字节比较，不一致时打印第一处差异），不一致就退出 1。
- `sync:presets` 从你安装的 DSH 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml` 重新生成，因此 `check:presets` 比较的其实是“仓库快照 vs 你机器上的 harness”。
- 这两条命令只在**源码检出**里有意义。普通用户经 `dsh plugin add` 安装的是已经打好的包，不需要跑；升级 harness 后如果上游改了 preset，应更新本仓库并重新安装。

生成器对上游 YAML 形状是**硬编码**的（`- insert:` 包装 + 4 空格缩进、`- id: compaction-basic` + `name:` 两行），形状一变就抛错要求更新，不会静默生成错误的东西。

## 它替换了什么

DSH 默认的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` 在上下文到达阈值后：

1. 先用 `tool-result-pruner` 无模型地剪掉超大工具结果（剪完低于阈值就结束）；
2. 仍需压缩时，**发起一次额外的 LLM 调用**（`purpose: "compaction"`）让模型按固定 8 节结构写检查点；
3. 用这条检查点替换最老的一段历史，保留最近约 16% 逐字。

本插件把第 2 步换成纯本地拼装。**第 1、3 步以及全部触发策略保持不变**。思路来自 ComeCode 的本地交接式压缩（`engine/apps/zcode-cli/packages/core/src/compact/local-handoff.ts`），但落在 DSH 官方的扩展点 `summarize()` 上，因此**不需要修改 harness 任何源码**。

| 行为 | 默认后端 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 触发阈值 | `floor(min(W × 0.8, W − O − headroom))` | 同 |
| 逐字保留近期尾部 | `retainRatio 0.16` | 同 |
| 工具结果剪枝 / 图片卸载 | 是 | 同 |
| 区间选择（工具配对安全、不遮蔽系统提示词） | 是 | 同 |
| 日志事务 / 并发锁 / 上下文溢出恢复 / `/compact` | 是 | 同 |
| 检查点怎么来 | **一次模型调用** | **本地拼装，0 次调用** |
| 检查点内容 | 模型自选措辞的 8 节 Markdown | 固定字段、逐字摘录、硬字符预算 |
| 上限 | 模型输出上限 | 6,000 字符，且不超过被遮蔽内容的一半 |
| 成本 / 延迟 | 每次触发都付费，还要等 | 免费、即时、可复现 |

## 交接文档里有什么

`<compacted-summary>` 内是一段有界文本（外层 preamble 由 DSH 自己加）：

- **guide**：不表示任务已完成；最新用户要求（压缩区间内最后一条）；提示完整原文仍在会话日志中、缺失细节按需重读。
- **summary**：阶段性要求/约束（历史内 system 更新，保留来源，标注“不作为新授权”）；压缩区间内涉及的文件（从工具调用参数提取，最多 25 个）；**回合级史书**（装了 [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) 时出现）；最近 4 次工具调用及结果（失败/成功/结果未记录）；最近一条助手进展原文摘录；未解决报错线索（最多 2 条）；上次交接摘录（非新指令）；以及“工具结果只保留预览”的收尾提示。

装了 `dsh-session-recall` 后，交接里会多一段**回合级史书**（≤2400 字符，且不超过交接预算的 40%）：它由会话日志折叠而来，所以**重复压缩也不会丢**——被上一次交接替换掉的早期回合，其结论仍然在里面。没装该 bundle 时行为与之前完全一致；史书读取失败也只会退化成没有这一段，不会让压缩失败。

各字段有独立字符预算（用户要求 1600、进展 900、单条工具 280、约束 300、旧交接 1200），总计硬上限 6,000 字符；实际预算还会被压到“被遮蔽字符数的一半减 600”（600 是给 DSH 固定 wrapper 留的余量）。凭据形态的文本（`sk-…`、`Bearer …`、`api_key=`、`password`/`secret`/`token`）会被 redact，`<thinking>` 块被剥离。

## 验证

### 1. 确认包已安装

PowerShell 与 zsh 相同：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web why dsh-compaction-local-handoff
```

预期输出（版本号以实际安装为准；`0.2.2` 是本源码检出的版本）：

```
dsh-compaction-local-handoff@0.2.2
└── dsh-profile-web (dependencies)

Found 1 version of dsh-compaction-local-handoff
```

注意：这只能证明**装上了**，不能证明 host 已经加载它。见下一步。

### 2. 确认运行时真的走了本地后端

在一个 `agentPreset: "standard"` 的 web 会话里执行 `/compact`，然后看压缩记录/会话日志：

```
17:53:57.134  compaction/start
17:53:57.145  compaction/summary   provider=local  model=local-handoff
              shadowedRange 8-61 · 21 nodes · 5713 tokens
              llmStreamCall=无 · rawOutput=无 · usage=无 · maxTokens=无
```

关键是 `provider=local`、`model=local-handoff`，且摘要事件**不带** `llmStreamCall` / `usage` / `maxTokens`——模型摘要路径一定会带这三者。节点数与 token 数应同界面报告的“已压缩 21 条历史记录（约 5713 tokens）”一致；这条记录 11 毫秒完成。

本仓库还验证过**根路径**：一次性 profile + 小窗口强制触发自动压缩（`compaction (step pressure)`），同样得到 `provider: "local"`、`model: "local-handoff"`，`compaction/start` → `compaction/summary` 间隔 2 毫秒。同时验证到：

- 交接里的“最新用户要求”是**真用户指令**，不是被注入的 `<system-reminder>`（技能目录 / AGENTS.md / 运行时上下文）；
- 反复压缩时上一次交接被当**数据合并**（最多一条 `上次交接携带的文件（可能已过时）`），不会层层嵌套；
- 被遮蔽区间变小时交接跟着变小，能通过后端的“必须比源内容更小”检查。

日志行本身不变：`compaction (step pressure): shadowed N surface nodes ...`。

想在隔离环境里试：`dsh plugin --profile <新 profile> add "<本仓库绝对路径>"`，再用小窗口强制触发自动压缩（做法同本仓库测试）。
