plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: 手机端交互与可读性适配：抽屉式侧栏（滑动开合 + 可调宽度）、滑动手势、触控命中区、软键盘避让、正文字号下限。Mobile interaction & readability layer for DSH Web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile-adapt

在手机上用 DSH Web，手感更顺一点。

原版界面是按电脑设计的：侧栏挤在一列里、按钮太小不好点、键盘弹出来挡住输入框、字偏小。这个插件把这些都调成适合手指用的样子。

## 功能

**侧栏变成抽屉**

- 右滑打开，左滑收起，手指跟着走；
- 宽度可以调：点一下按钮换一档（60% / 75% / 90% / 满屏），按住左右拖能连续调；
- 调过的宽度会记住，下次打开还是那样。

**手势**

- 右滑：打开侧栏；
- 左滑（侧栏开着时）：收起侧栏；
- 返回键：先关弹窗，再关侧栏，不会一不小心退出 App。

**会话列表好点也好认**

- 标题放大到 16px，长标题**折成两行**显示，不再一刀切成「手机端 dsh 适配手机交…」；
- 每行的时间（6 分钟 / 1 天）保留并放大，随时知道上次是什么时候聊的；
- 行末只留一个 `⋯` 按钮，归档、置顶、重命名都在它弹出的菜单里，不再占三格；
- 按钮放大到 40×40，行高跟着变高，拇指点得准；
- **拖动排序保留原样**：按住标题拖就能调整顺序，插件不拦这个手势。

**点得准**

- 按钮和菜单项放大到手指好按的大小，按下去有反馈；
- 去掉点完要等一下才能点的老毛病。

**键盘不挡输入框**

- 弹出键盘时界面自动往上让，输入框始终看得见。

**字更清楚**

- 正文最小 15px，输入框固定 16px；
- 你要是自己调过字号，插件不会覆盖，只是保证不会小于 15px。

**滚动不跑偏**

- 代码块、表格可以单独左右滑，不会把整个页面拖歪。

## 安装

```sh
bash install.sh              # 安装
bash install.sh --uninstall  # 卸载
```

装完刷新页面就生效，不用重启。

## 想自己调

打开 `lib/client.js`，改这几个：

| 改什么 | 找这个 |
| --- | --- |
| 多大的屏幕才算手机 | `PHONE_QUERY` |
| 正文最小字号 | `MIN_CONTENT_PX` |
| 宽度有哪几档 | `WIDTH_STEPS` |
| 默认宽度 | `DEFAULT_RATIO` |

改完重新跑 `bash install.sh`，刷新页面。

## 兼容

- 不往顶栏加按钮，也不强行改别的插件的控件大小，和大多数插件能一起用；
- 支持 **DSH 0.2 及以后所有版本**（没有写死版本上限，市场里升级到高版本 DSH 也不会被判定不兼容）；
- 只在窄屏（宽度 ≤767px）生效，电脑上不会改变任何东西。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# WordCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![WordCraft Use — editable business documents](assets/official-logo.png)

> Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents from an agent session, with real section structures, native tables, and a reopened-file check before handoff.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-16-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`wordcraft` turns source material into an editable document rather than a text dump: it collects the real facts, fills a section and field structure, lays the result out with native headings, tables, page numbers, and headers, then reopens the file and checks what the reader will actually see. It wraps the native WordCraft engine in sixteen skills and one embedded editor.

This is an installable development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, embedded host synchronization is not accepted, and short one-page samples do not prove that arbitrary long documents paginate correctly.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `wordcraft` |
| Display name | WordCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.5` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | WordCraft 0.7.0 via `wordcraft-cli` |
| Marketplace | `wordcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package already contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Native file workflows use `wordcraft-cli`, which this plugin does not install. Query the installed version and command schema before running a recipe.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or an existing verified editor cache. Complete release ZIPs can start offline from bundled assets.
- Windows Git installs need long-path support: `git config --global core.longpaths true`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add wordcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

The repository also ships its own marketplace metadata (`wordcraft-marketplace`) pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.5`. Restart the host, open a new task, and state the document type and the real source material.

## Quick start

1. Say what to produce and from what: “Write this week's report from these work notes; mark anything missing as pending confirmation.”
2. Let the agent choose the document skill and fill real fields. Templates describe sections, required fields, and native layout operations; they are not empty outlines with a new title.
3. Ask for a new editable DOCX plus a review PDF. Templates are designed for new documents, not for overwriting an existing file.
4. Reopen the DOCX, check heading levels, cell-by-cell table content, and column counts, then compare against the PDF page.

```text
Meeting minutes: turn these notes into minutes with decisions and action items.
Weekly report: summarize progress, blockers, and next week's plan.
Proposal: produce a project proposal with phases, deliverables, and owners.
Quotation: build a line-item table with quantities and decimal prices; do not infer tax.
```

Direct CLI form for file tasks, one method per argv argument; verify text afterwards with `wordcraft-cli text out.docx`:

```bash
wordcraft-cli run --cmd 'text.insert={"text":"Body text"}' --save out.docx
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Meeting minutes | `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Decisions, owners, and action items in an editable table |
| Weekly report | `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Completed, in-progress, blocked, and next-step sections kept separate |
| Project proposal | `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Goals, phases, deliverables, and planned dates |
| Requirements document | `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Numbered requirements with observable acceptance conditions |
| Acceptance report | `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Expected versus actual results, with failed items preserved |
| Business letter | `wordcraft-business-letter` | Recipient, subject, confirmed facts, and requested reply |
| Commercial quotation | `wordcraft-quotation` | Native line-item table, per-line amounts, and a checked total |
| Research and resume layout | `wordcraft-research-report`, `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Structured sections, figures, references, and a compact layout |
| Long-form structure | `wordcraft-toc-handbook`, `wordcraft-illustrated-guide`, `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Updatable table of contents, captioned figures, and portrait body with landscape appendix |
| Revision and playbooks | `wordcraft-document-comparison`, `wordcraft-document-style`, `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Text and structure diff, unified styles, eight checked recipes |

## Skills

### Document templates

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Build minutes from discussion, decisions, and action items |
| `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Build a weekly report from work records, progress, and next-week plans |
| `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Build a proposal with goals, approach, plan, and delivery |
| `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Turn interviews or drafts into numbered, testable requirements |
| `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Record acceptance criteria, measured results, and open issues |
| `wordcraft-business-letter` | Draft a business letter from recipient, subject, and confirmed facts |

### Commercial and layout

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-quotation` | Compile explicit line items into a native table and verify decimal totals |
| `wordcraft-research-report` | Lay out abstract, sections, figures, tables, and references |
| `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Lay out experience and outcomes in a compact resume |
| `wordcraft-document-style` | Unify headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables across a document |

### Long-form and comparison

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-toc-handbook` | Produce a handbook with an updatable table of contents |
| `wordcraft-illustrated-guide` | Produce a guide with images and captions |
| `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Combine a portrait body with a landscape matrix appendix |
| `wordcraft-document-comparison` | Compare two versions for textual and structural differences |

### Session and playbooks

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |
| `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes for project briefs, SOPs, release notes, decision tables, letters, training decks, and two-column briefs |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `wordcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the pinned engine's document tool catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace`; the first call binds the workspace |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for the same session when the host has a built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready

# dsh-desktop-notify

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Desktop notifications for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
A Windows toast appears when a Session needs you — and clicking it brings that
Session back to the front.

Two triggers:

| Trigger | When it fires |
| --- | --- |
| **Needs attention** | The Agent is blocked waiting for your approval or your answer. |
| **Run finished** | A Session that was running has stopped, and the run lasted at least `minRunMs`. |

## Install

Requires the **Desktop** application (the Windows toast path depends on Electron
running the renderer; a browser tab has no AppUserModelID to notify under).

### From the DSH plugin page (no terminal)

Open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and paste one of these into
**Package name or address**:

| What you paste | When to use it |
| --- | --- |
| `github:guanhaisen/dsh-desktop-notify` | Straight from this repository. Nothing published to npm. |
| `https://github.com/guanhaisen/dsh-desktop-notify` | Same thing, written as a URL. |
| `D:\path\to\dsh-desktop-notify` | A local checkout. **Must be an absolute path.** |

Then press **Install**. The plugin manager runs `pnpm add` in your profile, adds
the bundle to the profile's list, and the notification half activates without a
restart in most cases — reload the page (`Ctrl+R`) if the first toast does not
arrive.

> Installing from git resolves the repository's **default branch**. If you fork
> this and your default branch differs, paste the full spec with a ref instead:
> `github:you/dsh-desktop-notify#main`.

> The plugin page states that installed plugins **do not auto-update**: to
> upgrade, uninstall and install again. A `github:` install follows the default
> branch, so reinstalling picks up new commits.

### From the command line

```bash
# In your DSH desktop profile directory:
#   Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add github:guanhaisen/dsh-desktop-notify
```

Or link a working copy, so edits apply on save:

```bash
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-desktop-notify
```

Either way, the package must then appear in that directory's `package.json`
bundle list — the plugin page does this for you; a manual install does not:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...existing bundles...", "dsh-desktop-notify"]
    }
  }
}
```

> Keep this package free of runtime `dependencies`. pnpm does not install a
> linked package's own dependencies, and a resolution failure during Cordis tree
> initialisation stops DSH from starting.

### You will not see a toast when…

This is the part that looks like a bug and is not:

| Situation | Why it is silent |
| --- | --- |
| You are looking at that Session | The prompt is already on screen. |
| The run was shorter than `minRunMs` (20 s) | A quick reply is not news. |
| The Session was already running when the window opened | The first snapshot is a baseline, so opening DSH does not fire a burst. |
| Windows **Do Not Disturb** is on | The OS suppresses the banner. The notification still reaches the notification centre. |

If none of those apply and nothing appears, read the decision log — see
[Verifying it actually works](#verifying-it-actually-works). It records every
suppression *with its reason*, so "why did I not get a toast?" is answerable.

## Why this is a plugin and not a shell patch

The obvious implementation — add a `Notification` call to the Electron main
process — cannot work here, and understanding why explains the whole design.

The Desktop Host is **not** the Electron main process. `lib/main.js` spawns it as
a *separate Node child process*:

```js
spawn(this.node, ['--expose-internals', entry, ...], { stdio: ['ignore','pipe','pipe','ipc'] })
```

That child is the Electron executable re-entered in Node mode, so
`require('electron')` inside a Host plugin yields no `Notification`, and the
process holds no AppUserModelID. Meanwhile the shell's own notification code
(`lib/main.js`) only ever fires for one thing: a mandatory update.

The renderer, however, has everything needed:

- `dsh-app:` is registered as a privileged scheme with `standard: true` and
  `secure: true`, making the window a **secure context**, which the Web
  Notification API requires.
- The application session installs a permission handler that returns `true` for
  every non-media permission.

So a plain Web `Notification` in the window becomes a real Windows toast under
the application's own identity (`electron.app.DeepSeek Harness`). No shell
patch, no helper process, and it survives application updates.

## Where the state comes from

Nothing is polled and no second source of truth is created.
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` already folds exactly these facts and
publishes them as `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus`:

```
Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>
```

It is fed by the `api-session/status` Remote event. This plugin only reads it.

`pendingInteraction` is the interaction object itself, whose `kind` is one of:

| `kind` | Raised by | Copy shown |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approval` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval` | Tool named in the request is asking for privileged execution |
| `question` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` | The Agent asked a question |
| `plan-review` | same, when the questions are a plan | A plan is waiting for review |

Its `key` is the identity used to de-duplicate, so a status re-emission for the
same wait never produces a second toast.

## Layout

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half. Owns the Loader row the browser half binds to. Registers nothing — no tool, no service, no route. |
| `client.js` | Browser half. Watches Session status, decides when to notify, renders the toast, wires click-through, and publishes the `DesktopNotify` Inspect provider. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The one Host row the bundle inserts. |
| `test/watcher.test.mjs` | Behavioural test of the decision logic, runnable with plain `node`. |

## Configuration

Set on the plugin's row in the profile patch, or via the Plugins page:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notifyOnAttention` | `true` | Notify when a Session is blocked on you. |
| `notifyOnComplete` | `true` | Notify when a run finishes. |
| `minRunMs` | `20000` | Ignore runs shorter than this. Quick replies are not news. |
| `sound` | `true` | Play the system notification sound. |

### De-duplication

A repeated interaction never re-notifies: identity is the interaction's own
`key`, so a status re-emission for the same pending approval stays silent. The
first snapshot after the window opens is treated as a baseline rather than as
news, which is what stops a launch from firing a burst of toasts for Sessions
that were already running.

## Verifying it actually works

Delivery is asynchronous and visual, and neither half can observe the toast the
operating system renders. So the browser half publishes a Cordis Inspect
provider, `DesktopNotify`, which can be queried from outside the page:

| Method | Answers |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Is the half mounted? What is `Notification.permission`? Is this a secure context? Which Sessions are tracked, and since when? |
| `testToast` | Fire one real toast now, and report what was constructed. |
| `decisions` | The in-memory decision log — every notification sent *and* every one deliberately suppressed, with the reason. |

`decisions` is the one that answers "why did I not get a toast?": a suppressed
entry carries `suppressed: 'watched'` (you were looking at that Session) or
`suppressed: 'too-short'` (the run ended before `minRunMs`).

The log is **in memory only**, bounded to the last 100 entries. It is
deliberately not written to disk: a file that can silently fail to appear is
worse than no file at all.

### Confirming against the OS

`testToast` reporting `delivered: true` only means a `Notification` was
constructed. To confirm it reached the operating system, compare Windows' own
record for this app's AUMID before and after:

```powershell
$k = 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Notifications\Settings\electron.app.DeepSeek Harness'
[DateTime]::FromFi

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 工具插件：一句「帮我生成本周周报」即得固定四模块 Markdown 周报；内置流水线，装上即用。
plugins.readme_text:
# mimetics-dsh-weekly-report

> **装上后，在 Harness 对话框说一句「帮我生成本周周报」，就能拿到固定四模块的 Markdown 周报**
> （〖本周完成〗〖进行中〗〖风险与阻塞〗〖下周计划〗）——由 `generate_weekly_report` 工具驱动内置流水线生成。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/mimetics-ai/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add mimetics-dsh-weekly-report
```

从 GitHub 直装（等价写法）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mimetics-ai/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report
```

安装后**重启 `dsh web`**，然后在对话框里直接说：

> 帮我生成本周周报，素材是：本周把登录页崩溃修完了，数据看板还在联调……

**验证已挂载**（二选一）：

1. **设置 → 插件**：应能看到 `mimetics-dsh-weekly-report`；
2. 打开调试日志（安装后设置环境变量 `WEEKLY_REPORT_DEBUG=1` 再启动 `dsh web`），启动日志会打印：

```
[weekly-report] generate_weekly_report 已注册 | plugin v1.3.0 | pipeline v1.1.2 | projectRoot=… | python=…
```

---

## 它做什么

- **把散素材收成一份周报**：工作记录 / 聊天摘录 / Jira 工单 / Excel 表 / 会议纪要 / 日志，可混着给；
- **合并同类项**：同一件事在不同来源出现多次时合并为一条，并在诊断里说明合并依据；
- **区分状态**：自动分到〖本周完成〗〖进行中〗〖风险与阻塞〗〖下周计划〗四个固定模块；
- **冲突不擅自取舍**：跨来源状态矛盾、或同一对象报了不同数值时，**归入〖风险与阻塞〗并写明冲突点**；
- **绝不编造**：数值/日期一律取自素材原文；缺数据的条目不做估算，只在诊断里提示。

## 工具入参

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `materials` | `string[]` | ✅ | 素材列表。每项可以是**文件绝对路径**（`.md`/`.txt`/`.csv`/`.xlsx`），也可以是**素材原文文本**，两者可混用 |
| `outPath` | `string` | ✖ | 额外输出路径，把 Markdown 另存一份（目录自动创建） |

## 输出示例

```markdown
〖本周完成〗
- 修复登录页在 iOS 上的崩溃问题，回归通过
- 数据看板优化，覆盖 3 个核心指标
〖进行中〗
- 对账模块重构，已提测
〖风险与阻塞〗
- ⚠️ 数值冲突：跨素材数值不一致（3 条规则 / 5 条规则），完成风控规则配置，覆盖 3 条规则
〖下周计划〗
- 待确认
```

---

## 权限与风险（Clear risk）

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **运行依赖** | 本机需有 **Python 3.9+**（实测 3.13 / 3.15）。插件通过 `execFile` 调用 Python 运行内置流水线；未找到解释器时会给出明确的配置指引 |
| **文件读写** | 只读写**包内流水线目录**与插件自己的临时目录；若你在配置里显式给出 `projectRoot`，则读写该目录下的 `src/`、`config/` |
| **网络** | **无任何网络请求**；不上传素材、不调用外部服务、无遥测 |
| **数据** | 素材只在本地进程间传递，产出物由你自行决定保存位置 |
| **权限** | 仅注册一个工具 `generate_weekly_report`，不申请额外系统权限、不执行生命周期脚本 |

## 配置

在 profile 的插件配置里可覆盖（一般无需配置，装上即用）：

| 配置键 | 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pythonPath` | `WEEKLY_REPORT_PYTHON` | 依次探测 PATH 上的 `python` / `python3` / `py` | Python 解释器：绝对路径或命令名 |
| `projectRoot` | `WEEKLY_REPORT_PROJECT_ROOT` | **包内 `pipeline/` 目录** | 流水线根目录（含 `src/pipeline.py` 与 `pipeline/config/config.json`） |
| `timeoutMs` | — | `120000` | 单次调用超时 |
| — | `WEEKLY_REPORT_DEBUG` | 未设置 | 设为 `1` 打印挂载与版本日志 |

## 兼容性

- **DSH**：`0.2.0-rc.2` 实测通过。peer 依赖：`@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.2.0-rc.2`。
  ⚠️ DSH 处于开发者预览，官方明确会有破坏性变更；**升级 dsh 后请核对本段与包的版本**。
- **Node**：`>= 20.11`（实测 22.x）。
- **平台**：Windows 实测；macOS / Linux 未验证（代码不依赖平台专有 API，理论上可用）。
- **Python**：3.9+；仅用标准库，不需要 `pip install` 任何东西。

## 排障

| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 启动日志没有 `[weekly-report]` | 确认已安装且 `WEEKLY_REPORT_DEBUG=1`；用 `dsh plugin --profile web list` 核对 |
| `未找到可用的 Python 解释器` | 显式配置 `pythonPath`，或设置 `WEEKLY_REPORT_PYTHON` |
| `未找到周报流水线入口` | 你的 `projectRoot` 配置指向了不含 `src/pipeline.py` 的目录；清掉该配置即回落到包内流水线 |
| 报 `素材文件不存在` | 这是**预期行为**：路径类入参若不存在会直接失败，而不是把路径当文本产出一份假周报 |
| 中文输出乱码 | 不应出现（插件强制 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8`） |

---

## 开发

见 [`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)（本地加载方式、源码结构、构建与自测）。

## 许可与声明

- **许可证**：[MIT](./LICENSE)
- **主体**：广州永摹纪智能科技有限公司
- **声明**：本项目是**社区插件**，非 DeepSeek 官方项目；遵循 DeepSeek Harness 插件规范
  （导出 `apply(ctx)`，通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明 bundle）。问题请在本仓库提 issue。

plugins.description: ai-course plugin for deepseek harness
plugins.readme_text:
# AI 课程（dsh-ai-courses）

把「一个学习诉求 + 手头资料」变成一门**结构化、可讲授、可反复翻阅、纯本地**的 AI 课程。

在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 `/ai-course` 建课，在侧边栏「AI 课程」里管课、按章节/知识点生成内容，在学习页里阅读图文、幻灯片与图表。课程数据全部落在本地文件里，可以直接打开、diff、备份或整目录拷贝。

> 适用：DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`，Web UI（含桌面端的 Web 界面）。  
> 运行形态：host + client 双半插件；包本身零运行时依赖。

---

## 目录

- [功能一览](#功能一览)
- [安装](#安装)
- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [参考资料与附件](#参考资料与附件)
- [配置](#配置)
- [数据与备份](#数据与备份)
- [升级、停用与卸载](#升级停用与卸载)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [从源码开发](#从源码开发)
- [License](#license)

---

## 功能一览

- **`/ai-course` 建课**：一句学习诉求（可带附件/资料路径）→ 课程、章节、知识点大纲。
  命令卡片显示推导阶段与用时；成功后同一条回复末尾出现可编辑的大纲卡片。
- **三种粒度生成内容**：整门课 / 某一章 / 单个知识点。后台任务，刷新页面不丢；
  宿主重启后残留任务标记为 `interrupted`，不会假装还在跑。
- **内容类型**：`图文`（Markdown）、`幻灯片`（Slidev 方言）。`音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验`
  目前按 Markdown 降级生成，界面标注「格式待定」。
- **学习页**：Markdown 子集、Slidev 播放器、Mermaid 图表、代码高亮、本地媒体。
  打开**有内容**的知识点 → `进行中`，离开 → `已掌握`；章节/课程进度自动聚合。
- **课程库**：按标签/分类过滤、按名称搜索、打开大纲、进入学习、删除课程（整个课程目录）。
- **课程库设置**：右上角配置按钮可直接修改 `courseRoot`，保存后立即切换目录，无需重启。
- **纯本地数据**：`<courseRoot>/<courseId>/` 下的 JSON + Markdown；无外部存储 backend。
- **引用资料**：建课诉求/附件里点名的文本文件会随课程保存，生成内容时作为「参考资料」注入 prompt。
- **不占用旧 `course` 格位**：面板与 slot id 是 `ai-courses`，可与在装的 `dsh-course-plugin` 共存。

### Agent 工具

模型在会话里可以直接调用三个工具；UI 与工具走同一张 RPC 方法表，语义一致：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `course_read` | 读取课程、大纲与学习进度；生成内容前先读上下文 |
| `course_generate` | 为整门课 / 某一章 / 某些知识点发起后台生成 |
| `course_content_asset_put` | 写回某个知识点的内容资产（正文一律 Markdown） |

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- 已安装并启动 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2 或更新版本**。
- 使用 **Web UI**：`dsh web`，或桌面端内置的 Web 界面。
  TUI / headless 没有课程面板（client half 的 `platform` 是 `web`）。
- DSH 进程对课程库目录有读写权限；默认是 `~/.dsh/ai-courses`。
- 内容生成需要可用的模型与会话（生成动作由某个会话承载模型调用）。
- 从源码构建时另需 Node.js 20+。

### 方式一：npm / CLI

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-courses
```

桌面端把 `web` 换成 `desktop`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ai-courses
```

这条命令会同时写入 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`，不需要手工编辑 profile。

> **已知版本问题**：
> ① 0.1.2 及更早在 `dsh web` 下，客户端在 sidebar 槽声明之前就注册 `sidebar.panellist`，
> 会报 `dsh-ai-courses: failed` —— **0.1.3 已修复**；
> ② 0.1.3 及更早在中文 DSH 下仍可能显示英文 —— apply 时把 `<html lang>` 的初始 `en` 锁死，
> **0.1.4 起修复**（动态读取语言）。
> 建议安装 **0.1.4 或更新版本**。

> 如果 registry 上还搜不到 `dsh-ai-courses`（首次发布尚未完成），用方式三或方式四。

### 方式二：插件市场（推荐）

先确认已安装插件市场：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
```

重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → 插件市场**，搜索「AI 课程」并安装。

> 桌面端通常已内置插件市场；没有的话把 `web` 换成 `desktop` 装一次。
> 如果市场里还搜不到，说明尚未收录；用下面的 npm 或本地方式。

### 方式三：从源码构建安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aix-plugin/ai-courses.git
cd ai-courses

# Mermaid 是浏览器按需加载的 vendor 文件；仓库已带，缺失时下载
node scripts/vendor-mermaid.mjs

# src/ → package/
node scripts/build.mjs

# 安装的是构建产物 package/，不是仓库根目录
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/package"
```

> ⚠️ 仓库根目录没有 `package.json`，`dsh plugin add` 必须指向 `package/`。

### 方式四：本地 tarball（内网/离线分发）

```bash
cd ai-courses/package
npm pack
# 产出 dsh-ai-courses-<version>.tgz
# 注意用绝对路径：dsh plugin 在 profile 目录里执行 pnpm，相对路径会解析错
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/dsh-ai-courses-<version>.tgz"
```

### 安装后确认

1. **完全退出并重新打开 DSH**。新装 bundle 有时能热加载，但**替换/升级必须重启**才能加载新的 JS 模块。
2. 打开 **设置 → 插件**，确认 `dsh-ai-courses` 存在且已启用。
3. 侧边栏出现「AI 课程」面板。
4. 在会话里输入 `/`，能看到 `/ai-course`。

如果只有面板没有命令，或只有命令没有面板，通常是 host/client 有一半没加载：重启并查看宿主日志。

---

## 快速开始

### 1. 建课

在任意会话里发送：

```
/ai-course 用 3 章讲清 React Server Components，我熟悉 Vue 不熟 React
```

也可以带上资料：

```
/ai-course 根据 ./docs/rsc-spec.md 和附件，用 3 章讲清 React Server Components
```

建课时会发生：

- 命令卡片显示「已收到诉求，正在交给模型 / 已拿到课程结构，正在校验 / 正在写入课程库」等阶段与用时。
- 成功后回复末尾出现**课程大纲卡片**：章节、知识点、类型、时长（内容生成后回填）、生成状态、学习进度。
- 可以直接在卡片里改名、增删章节与知识点，也可以点「打开完整大纲」。
- 如果已存在同名课程，会先展示已有大纲并询问是否新建，避免误建重复课程。

### 2. 管理课程

打开侧边栏「AI 课程」：

- 课程库：按标签/分类过滤，按名称搜索。
- 课程库右上角的配置图标：修改 `courseRoot`，保存后立即切换（见[配置](#配置)）。
- 课程卡片：名称、描述、标签、学习进度、大纲入口、学习入口、删除。
- 大纲页：修正章节/知识点，发起内容生成。

### 3. 生成内容

在大纲页、学习页或生成弹窗里选择范围：

- 生成整门课内容
- 生成本章全部内容
- 生成这个知识点

说明：

- 生成在后台进行，界面按约 1.5s 轮询进度；刷新页面不丢任务。
- 已有内容时会询问「保留并追加」还是「覆盖」。
- 生成需要由一个会话承载模型调用；如果提示「先打开任意会话」，先在左侧新建/打开一个会话。
- 宿主重启后，未完成的任务会标记为 `interrupted`，可以重新发起。
- 输入框上方的常驻状态条会显示「正在为哪门课写哪个知识点 / 已完成几个」，切换面板也能看到。

### 4. 学习

点击课程卡片上的「学习」，或在大纲里点某个已生成内容的知识点：

- `图文`：本地 Markdown 正文；支持 Mermaid 图表、代码高亮、示意图。
- `幻灯片`：Slidev 方言 Markdown，按页播放，支持讲稿。
- `音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验`：当前按 Markdown 降级展示，标注「格式待定」。
- 打开**有内容**的知识点 → `进行中`；离开/切换 → `已掌握`。没有额外的「标记已掌握」按钮。

### 5. 删除课程

课程卡片底部 → 删除 → 二次确认。

删除会连同该课程的章节、知识点、内容资产、生成任务、学习进度**一起删掉**（删除整个课程目录），且不可撤销。如果只是暂时不用这个插件，先在设置里停用它，不要删课程数据。

---

## 参考资料与附件

建课时可以通过两种方式提供资料：

1. **附件**：输入框的附件按钮，或 `@` 选择文件。
2. **诉求里的路径**：例如 `./docs/spec.md`、`@/tmp/notes.md`、`~/notes/spec.yaml`。

边界：

- 只读取**文本类**文件（md / txt / json / yaml / ts / py / csv 等）。
- 图片、二进制、URL 不会被抓取；不联网抓网页。
- 最多 **6 个**引用；单文件 **6000 字符**、单次合计 **24000 字符**，超出会截断并在 prompt 里标注「以上为节选」。
- 文件不存在 / 不是文本 / 无权限时**静默跳过**，不会阻断建课或生成。
- 诉求原文与附件副本会存进课程目录的 `sources/`，之后生成知识点时继续作为参考资料。

---

## 配置

### `courseRoot`

默认课程库：

```
~/.dsh/ai-courses
```

### 从界面修改（推荐）

课程库右上角 → **配置图标** → 修改「课程库目录（courseRoot）」→ **保存并切换**。

- 保存后**立即生效**，不需要重启 DSH；课程库会刷新到新目录。
- 旧目录里的课程**不会被移动或删除**；切回旧路径仍然能看到。
- 有生成任务或课程推导在跑时不允许切换，等任务结束再试。
- 设置保存在当前 profile 目录的 `ai-courses.settings.json`，**优先于** profile patch 里的 `courseRoot`。
- 目录必须是绝对路径；`~` 会展开；目标目录必须可写（host 会自动创建并做一次写探测）。
- 弹窗里会显示「当前生效」目录、来源（默认值 / profile 配置 / 界面设置）和设置文件位置。

### 从 profile patch 修改（默认/回退）

没有界面设置时，`courseRoot` 取自对应 profile 的 patch（web 示例）：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: ai-courses
  name: dsh-ai-courses
  config:
    courseRoot: /Users/you/Documents/ai-courses
```

桌面端对应 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`。

规则：

- 支持 `~` 展开；展开后必须是**绝对路径**，相对路径会被拒绝。
- patch 里的 `config` 是**整体替换**，不是深合并；插件会自动回填缺省值。
- 改完重启 DSH 生效。
- 一旦在界面里保存过设置，`ai-courses.settings.json` 会覆盖 patch 值；删掉该文件并重启，才会回到 patch 值。
- `maxParallelGenerations`、`defaultContentType` 目前只是配置兼容保留，**不改变运行时行为**，不要把它们当开关。

### 其他

- 插件包名：`dsh-ai-courses`
- bundle patch 行 id：`ai-courses`
- client platform：`web`
- 零运行时依赖；不写会话事件

---

## 数据与备份

### 目录结构

```
<courseRoot>/                         默认 ~/.dsh/ai-courses
└── c-20261013142530-a7f3/            课程 id = 目录名
    ├── course.json                   课程元数据 + 大纲 + schemaVersion
    ├── progress.json                 学习进度（只存知识点层）
    ├── tasks.json                    内容生成任务
    ├── content-assets/
    │   ├── <kpId>.json               内容资产信封（元数据、mediaRefs）
    │   ├── <kpId>.md                 图文正文
    │   ├── <kpId>.slides.md          幻灯片正文
    │   └── media/                    示意图等本地媒体
    └── sources/                      诉求原文与附件副本
        ├── request.md
        └── <附件文件名>
```

- `course.json` 里内联章节与知识点；`progress.json` 只存知识点进度，章节/课程进度由它派生。
- 正文里的媒体引用是**课程目录内的相对路径**，整个课程目录可以搬走。
- 删除课程 = 删除这一个目录，不存在跨系统的非原子删除。

### 备份与迁移

直接复制整个 `<courseRoot>`：

```bash
cp -R ~/.dsh/ai-courses ~/backup/ai-courses-$(date +%F)
```

换机器时把目录拷过去，然后在课程库右上角的配置里把 `courseRoot` 指到新位置（或删掉 `ai-courses.settings.json` 后改 profile patch、重启）。

### 版本与损坏

- 每个结构化 JSON 文件都有 `schemaVersion`；`course.json` / `progress.json` 带版本守卫。
- 如果 `course.json` / `progress.json` 来自**更新版本**的插件，旧代码会**只读降级**：可浏览、禁止写入，不会静默改写你的数据。
- JSON 解析失败时，该文件降级为空，并把原文件另存为 `.corrupt-<时间戳>`，其他课程不受影响。
- 早期版本写入的 SVG 可能不是合法 XML，浏览器不显示。在仓库内跑一次清洗器（会先预演并备份 `.bak`）：

```bash
node scripts/repair-media.mjs --write
```

---

## 升级、停用与卸载

| 场景 | 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 升级（npm） | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ai-courses@latest` | 重启 DSH |
| 升级（市场） | 插件市场 → 更新 | 按提示重启 |
| 升级（本地 link） | `git pull && node scripts/build.mjs` | 重启 DSH |
| 升级（tarball） | 重新 `npm pack` 后 `dsh plugin add` 新 tgz | 重启 DSH |
| 临时停用 | 设置 → 插件 → 关闭 | 界面消失，课程数据保留 |
| 卸载 | 设置 → 插件 → 卸载（推荐）；或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ai-courses`，并确认 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里没有残留 | **不会删除课程数据** |
| 删除数据 | 手动删除 `<courseRoot>` | 不可撤销，先备份 |

升级注意：

- **替换已安装包必须重启**才能加载新的 JavaScript 模块；只刷新页面不够。
- slot id 没变不代表浏览器端代码已更新，以重启后的界面为准。
- 升级不会动课程数据；但如果 `schemaVersion` 升了，回滚到旧版本会让数据变成只读（这是刻意的保护）。
- 回滚最快的方式是先在「设置 → 插件」里停用，而不是卸载。

---

## 已知限制

- `音频` / `视频` / `代码` / `测验` 目前只按 Markdown 降级生成，标注「格式待定」。
- `测验` 只展示题目与答案，不能作答判分。
- 音频/视频不做合成，只支持本地挂载素材。
- 课程数据纯本地，没有云同步；换机器需手动拷贝 `courseRoot`。
- 进度是轮询更新（约 1.5s），不是实时推送。
- 内容生成依赖模型与会话；模型不可用时无法生成。
- 幻灯片使用 Slidev 方言，但不是完整的 Slidev 运行时；只支持本插件实现的版式与能力。
- Mermaid 渲染器约 3.4 MB，按需加载；拿不到 vendor 文件时图表会降级成源码块，不会

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 里所有未声明 reasoningEfforts 的模型自动补上 high / xhigh / max 三档的 Host 插件：零运行时依赖、无构建步骤、幂等，写入走 configEditor 正常路径并刻意放在 HMR 事务之外。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-default-reasoning-efforts

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的 Host 插件：
**所有没有声明推理等级的模型，自动获得 `high / xhigh / max` 三档。**

配套 [dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider) 用：
滑条能不能滑到某档，取决于**模型有没有那一档**；本插件负责把缺的档位补上。

## 为什么必须改配置（而不是在界面上"造"三档）

档位不是 UI 变出来的，是 **Host 侧 LLM 适配器报出来的模型能力**：

```
profile 配置 reasoningEfforts
  → dsh-llm-pi-ai: resolveModelReasoning() → pi-ai thinkingLevelMap
  → getSupportedThinkingLevels() → reasoningInfo() → ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo()
  → 模型目录（浏览器）→ 官方菜单「推理等级」那一行 / 滑条刻度
```

配置里没写 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型，解析结果是 `reasoning: false`
（手写声明的模型不在 pi-ai 内置目录里，没有可继承的能力）。后果是双重的：

1. 模型目录里没有档位 → 官方菜单**连「推理等级」那一行都不渲染** → 滑条无处可挂；
2. 就算客户端硬塞一个档位，`dsh-llm` 在 `resolveCallWithInfo()` 里也会以
   `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` **直接拒掉这次请求**。

所以唯一端到端成立的做法是把档位写进 provider 配置，让适配器自己认。

## 它做什么

`apply()` 里做一次**幂等、可重入**的配置补齐：

1. 等目标 entry（默认 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`）出现在 `configEditor` 里（退避重试约 30 秒）；
2. 读它的**有效配置**，找出 `providers.<route>.models[]` 里所有 `reasoningEfforts` 未声明的模型；
3. 用官方 `ctx.configEditor.edit()` 写回 profile patch
   （走 Loader 正常路径：校验 → 原子写 → 失败回滚；**YAML 注释保留**）；
4. `ctx.emit('llm/adapters-updated')` —— 已连接的浏览器会**立刻重拉模型目录**，不用刷新页面。

**幂等**：没有任何要补的模型时，一个字节都不写，也不会触发重载循环
（档位已经等于目标档位的模型会被跳过，所以第二次运行是彻底的 no-op）。

**热装即可生效**（不用等重启）：写配置这一步被刻意放在 **HMR 事务之外**执行。
原因是实测踩到的坑 —— `configEditor.edit()` 内部是 `hmr.runExclusive()`，而
`runExclusive` 一旦发现自己已经处在一次 HMR 事务里就直接拒绝
（`HMR transactions cannot be nested`）；插件热装/热启用时 `apply()` 恰好跑在
这样一次事务里，而且 hmr 用的是 `AsyncLocalStorage`，上下文会顺着 `setTimeout`
一路传下去 —— 所以"晚一点再写"根本逃不出去（第一版插件就是这么**静默失败**的）。
现在照官方 `hmr.watchConfig` 的做法用 `AsyncLocalStorage.exit()` 把写入放到事务外，
拿不到就退回普通调用；写入被拒时还会退避重试（约 37 秒），绝不静默吞掉。

## 默认规则

| 模型状态 | 默认行为 |
|---|---|
| 没写 `reasoningEfforts` | **补上 `{high: high, xhigh: xhigh, max: max}`** |
| 写了 `reasoningEfforts: false` | 不动（显式声明"这个模型没有推理"，视为用户的明确选择） |
| 写了别的档位表 | 不动 |
| 写了但恰好就是这三档 | 不动（保证幂等） |

## 可选配置

`$DSH_HOME/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts/config.json`（**不存在就用内置默认值**，改完下次检查即生效）：

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" },
  "targets": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"],
  "providers": [],
  "includeDeclared": false,
  "dryRun": false
}
```

| 键 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `enabled` | `false` = 完全不动手（插件照常加载，只跳过补齐） |
| `levels` | 要补的档位表：键只能是 pi-ai 的七档名 `off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max`，值是**线上拼写**（`off` 允许 `null` = 不发送该参数） |
| `targets` | 要管的 entry **包名**（默认只动 pi-ai 适配器；别的适配器 schema 不同，别乱加） |
| `providers` | provider route 白名单（`[]` = 全部） |
| `includeDeclared` | `true` = 连已声明（含 `false`）的模型也覆盖成 `levels` |
| `dryRun` | `true` = 只在日志里说会改什么，不写文件 |
| `pollSeconds` | **兜底自检**间隔（秒，默认 30，`0` = 关掉）。见下 |

### 新加的模型什么时候会被补上

| 时机 | 会不会补 |
|---|---|
| **每次 DSH 启动** | **一定**。启动那次检查会扫全部模型，缺档位的一个不落 |
| 运行中在**设置页新增模型** | **会**，最多 `pollSeconds`（默认 30 秒）内 |
| 运行中**手改 `cordis.patch.yml` 文件** | 要等下次启动（实测：这个环境里 HMR 的配置监视没把文件改动送进运行中的 Loader；反正下次启动会补） |
| 插件被禁用（`enabled: false`） | 不补 |

为什么要有 `pollSeconds` 这个自检：宿主确实会发 `llm/adapters-updated` /
`settings/document-updated` / `hmr/reload` 这几个事件（插件都订阅了），
但"事件有没有送达"不在本插件的控制范围内 —— 与其把正确性押在上面，
不如按固定间隔自己看一眼：有活就干，没活就是一次纯读的 no-op。
30 秒一次的读取成本可以忽略，换来的是"新加的模型一定会被补上"这个确定性。

配置非法时会退回内置默认值并在日志里说明原因（不静默）。

## 回执：它到底做了什么

每次检查的结论会写到 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts/status.json`
（只在结果变化时写，不是每次事件都动磁盘）：

```json
{
  "at": "2026-10-14T01:41:46.342Z",
  "pid": 23388,
  "enabled": true,
  "targets": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"],
  "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" },
  "status": "patched",
  "matchedEntries": ["llm-pi-ai"],
  "changedModels": [{ "provider": "local", "model": "step-5-preview", "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" } }],
  "wrote": true,
  "error": null
}
```

`status` 取值：`patched`（补了）/ `no-change`（没活可干）/ `dry-run` / `waiting-entry`
（目标 entry 还没出现）/ `read-failed` / `write-failed` / `crashed` / `disabled`。
**排障第一步就是看这个文件** —— 它比宿主日志好找，也比"猜插件跑没跑"可靠。

## 安装

```powershell
# 面板：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 填仓库地址或本目录绝对路径
# 或命令行（非 desktop profile）：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:junjundesk/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts
# 本地开发时直接链本目录：
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"<本目录的绝对路径>"
```

零运行时依赖、无构建步骤（只用 node 内置模块），解开就能装。

## 测试

```powershell
node test/plan.test.mjs      # 43 项断言：档位规范化 / 配置规范化 / 补齐规划 / HMR 事务逃逸 / 端到端接线
```

测试里有一份**假 `configEditor`**：`edit()` 会把新配置落到 entry 上，所以"第二次运行必须
一个字节都不写"这件事是被真断言守着的，而不是靠肉眼。其中一项是**回归测试**：用真的
`AsyncLocalStorage` 模拟 hmr 的事务上下文，并让 `edit()` 在事务内直接抛
`HMR transactions cannot be nested` —— 它复现了第一版插件的真实故障，也守着修复不被改回去。

## 已知边界

- 只改 `providers.*.models[].reasoningEfforts` 这一个字段，其它字段原样保留。
- 补的是**声明**，不是"让模型真的会思考"：端点是否接受 `xhigh`/`max` 由上游决定，
  与你在同一个 provider 里给别的模型写的那套拼写保持一致。
- `targets` 默认只含 pi-ai 适配器。别的适配器（如官方 DeepSeek）有自己的固定档位表，
  强行补档位可能让请求被上游拒掉。
- 卸载/关掉后，已经写进 profile patch 的 `reasoningEfforts` **不会自动删掉**
  （那是你的配置，插件不替你回滚）——想恢复就把那几行删掉。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
